meta.what: The largest single-day English Wikipedia pageview count on record for each article, ranked, over every day the daily API covers.
meta.source: Wikimedia REST pageviews. Stage 1: top/en.wikipedia/all-access, one request per day. Stage 2: per-article/en.wikipedia/all-access/user.
meta.agents: users only. data/probe counts all agents and reads larger for the same peak. The two are never mixed inside one figure.
